verdict.rationale: Customer.io's first-party docs cover each part of the story. The official MCP server can read workspace data, work with segments and list all active automations. The CLI gives agents full access to the Journeys and Pipelines APIs with structured JSON, and the App API is documented for fetching data. The docs also say an AI client can analyze performance and report on how messages perform, and the built-in agent can run broadcast recaps. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of which campaign metrics are retrievable, independent or hands-on corroboration that agents can pull a full program-wide performance report.
